corrections.claim: The Ginzan Line timetable covering an Oct 20-23, 2026 trip is the one headed 2026/4/1～2026/10/24, published on base4.html. base.html carries only the 12月1日～3月31日 winter table and states of itself 「このページの情報は古いため、最新の情報は「時刻表・運賃」ページをご覧ください」 — so the transit section's timetable citation pointed at the wrong season, on a page the operator marks out of date.

corrections.previousValue: Oishida → Ginzan Onsen (the anchor transfer, carried with luggage): Hanagasa Bus, Ginzan Line, ≈35-40 min, ¥1,000/adult one-way, cash only (¥500 child or disabled companion), no reservation needed. The operator publishes a different timetable per season — the Apr 1 – Oct 24, 2026 table is the one covering this trip, and its departures run roughly 5-7 minutes later than the Dec 1 – Mar 31 winter table sitting beside it on the same page. First bus leaves Oishida ≈6:40; the last one in reaches Ginzan Onsen at 18:21. ⚠ The operator's summary page still advertises 5 round trips a day while its seasonal timetable lists more — read the timetable itself, and confirm the day of. Missing a bus means a 1.5-2.5h wait. Board early with the group's luggage; if the bus can't take it all, a taxi (≈20 min, ≈¥6,500-8,000/car, 2-3 cars for 8 people — call Ōbanazawa Taxi 0237-23-2525 ahead) is the fallback.

corrections.claim: The two seasonal Ginzan Line tables are on two separate pages (winter on base.html, Apr 1 – Oct 24 2026 on base4.html), and the trip's Apr-Oct table is not the winter table shifted 5-7 minutes: it lists Oishida departures 6:40 / 7:50 / 9:57 / 10:20 / 12:42 / 14:17 / 15:30 / 16:02 / 17:52 / 19:40 against the winter table's 6:40 / 7:50 / 9:50 / 12:35 / 14:10 / 15:55 / 17:45 — more services, not merely later ones. The largest gap on the trip's own table is the midday 10:20 → 12:42 (≈2h20), so the previous flat '1.5-2.5h wait' was read off the wrong season.

corrections.previousValue: Ginzan Onsen → Oishida (return): two departures to avoid, both flagged on the operator's own timetable — the 14:55 does not connect to a northbound (上り) Yamagata Shinkansen, and the last bus, 18:21, is expected to be crowded with no extra service added. The operator points passengers at 16:35 instead; 13:25 is the earlier clean option. With eight people, luggage and two low-mobility travelers, pick one of those two and confirm it at Ginzanso the night before.

corrections.claim: The ※/☆ service notes 「銀山温泉発14:55のバスは山形新幹線（上り）への接続が出来ません」 and 「最終便18:21発は混雑が予想されます。増便はありませんので16:35または17:00のご利用をお勧めします」 are published on base.html only, not on the Apr-Oct table page — so once the section's own source_url moved to base4.html this step needed its own citation to the page that carries the notes. All four named departures (13:25 / 14:55 / 16:35 / 18:21) also appear on the 2026/4/1～2026/10/24 table, so the advice holds for these dates.

corrections.previousValue:
Morning: Bunshokan (free, 9:00-16:30, with a rear wheelchair entrance, 10 loaner wheelchairs and a stair lift — the one city sight whose access is documented) or Yamagata Marugoto-kan Beninokura, a restored Edo-era merchant warehouse compound paired with Soba Sanbyakubou's 30-seat private room for lunch.

Withdraw cash before leaving the city — Ginzan Onsen has no ATM or convenience store. From Yamagata Station, take the JR Ōu Line to Oishida (≈50 min local / ≈28 min Tsubasa), then the Hanagasa Bus to Ginzan Onsen: {{fact:hanagasa-bus-fare-1000-yen}}, ≈35-40 minutes, no reservation needed, and only a handful of departures a day — the operator runs a different timetable per season, so read the April–October one. Board with the group's luggage in good time; missing a bus means waiting 1.5-2.5 hours for the next.

Check into Ginzanso (the largest property in town, best odds of hosting all 8 together) and see the street's gas lamps light ≈16:30-17:00 (seasonal — earlier as October's sunset comes sooner), best photo window 16:30-17:30.

corrections.claim: Continuity ripple of the same fact: on the trip's own Apr 1 – Oct 24, 2026 table the gap between Oishida departures runs from ≈23 minutes (9:57 → 10:20) to ≈2h20 (10:20 → 12:42), so the flat '1.5-2.5 hours' figure — carried from the winter table — understates the day's real worst case and overstates its best.

corrections.previousValue: Ōishida Station — the gateway to Ginzan Onsen — doesn't accept IC cards, and the bus onward is cash-only regardless. Carry cash for that whole leg.
corrections.correctedValue: The Hanagasa Bus onward from Ōishida is cash-only — the operator's own fare table states cash settlement only, no IC cards. ⚠ Multiple Japanese sources also report that JR Ōishida Station itself doesn't accept IC cards, but that half couldn't be confirmed against JR East. Carry cash for the whole leg.
corrections.claim: The cited page (the bus operator's Ginzan Line fare table) documents only the bus fare being cash-only — 「運賃は現金精算のみのお取り扱いとなっております。（ICカード不可）」. It carries nothing about JR Ōishida Station's IC readers, which the guide's own Transit step 3 and Plan → Local essentials both flag as unconfirmed against JR East. A divergences card asserting the unsourced half as corrected fact contradicted two other surfaces of the same guide.

corrections.previousValue:
Emergency numbers: police 110, ambulance/fire 119 — both free, nationwide, with English-speaking operators available.

Yamagata city has ordinary drugstore chains (Tsuruha Drug is common across Tohoku) for over-the-counter needs; English support is basic, not fluent medical consultation. Ginzan Onsen and Yamadera have no pharmacy — bring what the group needs for those days.

Confirm all travelers are current on routine vaccinations (MMR in particular) — Japan has reported elevated measles activity in 2026.

⚠ Routine vaccinations, MMR included, should be current before departure — check your own doctor or national health authority for Japan's current recommendations.
corrections.claim: The section's only citation is a pharmacy how-to that contains no information about measles activity, outbreaks in Japan in 2026, or recommended traveller vaccinations — confirmed by direct fetch. A perishable epidemiological claim carried on a citation that does not contain it is unsourced under verification-rules.md §3, and no health authority is reachable from this pass's allowed source domains, so the claim is withdrawn and the actionable, durable instruction kept with a ⚠.
